chestlog.panel.title: Chest log
chestlog.cp.done: CoreProtect: %s records added to the chest history.
chestlog.cp.too_far: Come closer to the chest: the CoreProtect inspector needs to click it.
chestlog.cp.unavailable: CoreProtect is not available here (no plugin or no permission for /co i).
chestlog.cp.no_reply: CoreProtect did not answer. Check that you can use /co i on this server.
chestlog.search.title: Chest Log — Where is it?
chestlog.search.none_saved: No chests remembered yet: just open them.
chestlog.search.nothing: Not found in the remembered chests
chestlog.config.title: Chest Log — Settings
chestlog.config.enabled.tooltip: Remember containers and show what changed.
chestlog.config.panel.tooltip: Where the log appears next to an open container.
chestlog.config.log_own.tooltip: Also add what you put in or took out to the history.
chestlog.config.history.tooltip: How many changes are kept per container.
chestlog.config.highlight.tooltip: How long a found container stays outlined in the world.
chestlog.config.coreprotect.tooltip: "Who took it?" in the panel: turns on the CoreProtect inspector (/co i), clicks the chest, reads who changed it and turns the inspector off again. Needs CoreProtect on the server and permission for /co i.
chestlog.config.cp_pages.tooltip: How many result pages to read (each page is a few records).
chestlog.config.clear.tooltip: Delete every remembered container of the current server / world.
